events.title: Founding of Ember Reach
events.summary: Riverfolk raise the first kiln-houses where the silt still held heat at dusk.

events.title: The Hearth Compact is sworn
events.summary: The Ashwardens promise to treat fire as a guest, and the Last Coal is set in the lodge.

events.title: The River Runs Dry
events.summary: The Ember river falls silent at the Dry Bend. Reeds keep the old channel's shape.

events.title: Mira Vale begins her survey
events.summary: A cartographer walks the dying banks and starts a map no one asked for.
